role: ChunkProviderServer.chunksToUnload (a Set over JDK 8 ConcurrentHashMap<Long>) with its iteration order carried as data: each key's list stamp inside its bin, per-bin counts and TreeBin roots, an open-addressed membership index.

structs.name: cu_slot
structs.java: ConcurrentHashMap Node / TreeNode: key, spread hash, the list position as a stamp, the red-black links

gpu: the order is a sort of the live keys by (bin, stamp): a plain put appends (the next stamp up), a tree put prepends (the next down), and a transfer keeps order (lane/gpuorder, L4)
